channels.C1: Thank you for letting us know about the water damage from the burst pipe. Your home-contents claim is now open, and your policy is active. One of our adjusters will contact you soon to arrange a visit to assess the damage. In the meantime, if it's safe, you may want to take photos of the affected items and keep any damaged belongings. That will help the process go smoothly. We're here to help you through this, so please reach out if you have any questions.
